dedupe_keys.name: troncons de route limite 30 et 50 km h ville de clermont ferrand

description: Troncons de route limite 30 et 50 km/h - Ville de Clermont-Ferrand is a dataset listed in Open Data Clermont-Ferrand, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Clermont-Ferrand ; Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Depuis le 1er décembre 2021, la vitesse est limitée à 30 km/h sur plus de 80% des axes de la ville. Ce jeu de données présente les tronçons de voies et leur limitation de vitesse (30 ou 50 km/h). La colonne "limitation" permet de différencier les différentes limitations. Coverage: Clermont-Ferrand. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are transport, vitesse, limitation, voie, route, Clermont-Ferrand. The portal shows 5,833 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermont-ferrand-fr-portal.
